description: Generate routes.xml, an action controller (GET page or POST JSON) and, for pages, the layout handle and template, for the frontend or adminhtml area (with ADMIN_RESOURCE and acl.xml for the Admin), adapted from the official routing docs. Returns the files for the caller to write.

aclResource.description: adminhtml only: ACL resource for ADMIN_RESOURCE (default "<Vendor_Module>::<controller>")

basePath.description: Module directory relative to the Commerce root (default "app/code/<Vendor>/<Module>")

frontName.description: URL front name: the first URL segment, <frontName>/<controller>/<action> (e.g. "reviews")

method.description: HTTP method: GET renders a page with a layout handle, POST returns JSON (default GET)

module.description: Module name as Vendor_Module (e.g. "Acme_Reviews"), as registered in registration.php

routeId.description: Route id in routes.xml and first part of the layout handle (default: frontName)

name: add-controller

files.description: Files to write. The server never writes to disk.

path.description: Path relative to the Commerce root

source.description: Documentation page the template was adapted from

title: Add a controller and route
